chunks: It will come upon them unawares, and they will not comprehend it.

key_terms.يَشْعُرُونَ: they feel, they perceive, they comprehend

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when divine punishment comes upon people unawares?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (26:203) underscores the concept of *ghaflah* (heedlessness), where the disbelievers are caught off guard by the reality of the Hereafter despite frequent reminders. It serves as a warning that divine retribution arrives not merely as a surprise, but as the inevitable culmination of a life lived in spiritual ignorance, contrasting with the preparedness of the *muttaqun* (the God-fearing).
